target: 将梅尔瓦的答复带给哈瓦尔

I've found the Amulet! I need to take this to Mehlva as proof of Havar's affection.
target: 我找到护符了！得把它交给梅尔瓦，证明哈瓦尔的心意。

source: Return to Havar with the good news
The Amulet held an incredible power over Mehlva and she loves the gift, I need to return to Havar to give the good news and retrieve my reward.
target: 护符对梅尔瓦有着非同寻常的影响，她非常喜欢这份礼物。我得回去把好消息告诉哈瓦尔，再领取报酬。

source: Speak to Mehlva
I lied to Mehlva and claimed to be the secret admirer, I should speak to her to claim my reward.
target: 我骗梅尔瓦说，我才是那个秘密仰慕她的人。该找她领取回报了。

source: Search for Clues
The camp has been looted by local Tombrobbers, I might be able to find a clue as to where they've stashed their loot.
target: 营地被附近的盗墓贼洗劫了。或许能找到线索，查出他们把赃物藏在哪里。

source: Find the Tombrobber Hideout and Stash
target: 寻找盗墓贼的藏身处与赃物

source: On one of the Tombrobbers I've found a key and a note about a local stash nearby, that must be where they're keeping the amulet.
target: 我在一名盗墓贼身上找到了一把钥匙，还有一张提到附近藏匿点的纸条。护符一定就藏在那里。

source: Talk to Mesahtnofret
target: 与梅萨特诺芙蕾特交谈

source: I've agreed to help Mesahtnofret save her village. I should ask about her plan.
target: 我答应帮梅萨特诺芙蕾特拯救她的村庄。该问问她有什么计划。

source: Find the Entrance to the Tomb

Mesahtnofret has directed me to a nearby tomb where an ancient warlord is buried. It is said that this leader used a powerful aphrodisiac that could drive anyone wild with lust. Mesahtnofret thinks that the recipe for this elixir may be hidden among the belongings buried with the warlord.
target: 梅萨特诺芙蕾特让我去附近一座埋葬着古代军阀的墓穴。据说，那位军阀曾使用一种强力春药，能让任何人欲火焚身。梅萨特诺芙蕾特认为，药剂配方可能藏在他的陪葬品中。

source: Search the Tomb for the Recipe

I have arrived at the tomb, but it is crawling with the restless dead. Finding the recipe may be more difficult than I had originally thought. I expect that it was hidden near the final resting place for this warlord.
target: 我来到墓穴，却发现这里到处是不安的亡灵。寻找配方或许比我原先想的更难。我猜它就藏在那位军阀的安息之所附近。

source: Return to Mesahtnofret
target: 返回梅萨特诺芙蕾特处

source: I have defeated the undead warlord and found the recipe in his remains! I should return to Mesahtnofret at once.
target: 我击败了亡灵军阀，并在他的遗骸中找到了配方！得立刻回去找梅萨特诺芙蕾特。

source: Ask Mesahtnofret about the missing ingredient
target: 向梅萨特诺芙蕾特询问缺少的材料

source: Mesahtnofret says that she has all but one of the required ingredients for the elixir. I should ask where I can find the missing ingredient.
target: 梅萨特诺芙蕾特说，配制药剂所需的材料只差一种。该问问她去哪里找。

source: Find the Acolyte of Seshat

Mesahtnofret does not know where to find the missing ingredient, but she thinks that an acolyte of Seshat may have that knowledge. She directed in the direction of the last acolyte who passed through.
target: 梅萨特诺芙蕾特不知道去哪里寻找缺少的材料，但她认为塞莎特的侍祭可能知道。她告诉了我上一位途经此地的侍祭离开的方向。

source: Speak with the Acolyte
I have found the acolyte's camp. I should find the acolyte and ask about the missing ingredient.
target: 我找到了侍祭的营地。该找到她，询问那种缺少的材料。

source: I have accepted the acolyte's offer. I should return to Mesahtnofret, but what should I tell her?
target: 我接受了侍祭的提议。该回去找梅萨特诺芙蕾特了，可我该怎么向她解释？

source: I have lied to Mesahtnofret. Her village is doomed, but at least she doesn't know that there was a chance.
target: 我骗了梅萨特诺芙蕾特。她的村庄在劫难逃，但至少她不会知道，村子原本还有一线生机。

source: Defeat the Acolyte
I have rejected the acolyte's offer. she did not take kindly to that. I must defeat her.
target: 我拒绝了侍祭的提议，她对此很不高兴。我必须击败她。

source: Gather Enough Petals for the Village
target: 为村庄收集足够的花瓣

source: The acolyte mentioned that the night lotus grew in this area. I should try to find it and gather enough blossoms to cure the village.
target: 侍祭提到夜莲就生长在这一带。我该找找看，采集足够的花朵来救治村民。

source: I have gathered enough of the lotus petals. I should return them to Mesahtnofret.
target: 我收集到了足够的莲花花瓣。该把它们带给梅萨特诺芙蕾特。

source: The Cure
Mesahtnofret now has everything that she needs to prepare the elixir and will soon give the cure to her people.
target: 梅萨特诺芙蕾特已经集齐了配制药剂所需的一切，很快就会把解药交给村民。

I've been tasked to find a farmer's son and fieldhand who have a habit of sneaking off. They can't have gone too far.

I've found a camp not too far from the farmer's land, perhaps this is where they snuck off to. I should have a look around.
target: 我在离农田不远的地方发现了一处营地。或许两人偷偷跑到了这里，我该四处看看。

The shade said that they would return when the need arises.. Whatever that means.
target: 幽影说，等到有需要时就会回来……不管那是什么意思。

I've been instructed to 'fulfill my carnal desires' by the shade, I should find someone who meets my tastes.
target: 幽影让我“满足肉欲”。我该找个合自己口味的人。

Harabi's asked me to try and find a way to extend her punishment since her time's nearly up, perhaps the best place to start is the person she's strapped to.
target: 哈拉比的刑期快结束了，她却让我想办法延长惩罚。或许该先问问那个和她绑在一起的人。

I've successfully managed to extend Harabi's punishment, she'll be delighted to hear it.

target: 哈拉比答应送我一对腿带，作为帮助她的报酬。她说腿带就在附近她的家里。

Find out what happened to the Anubites

target: 我遇见了一群受伤的阿努比斯族人。据其中一位女祭司所说，他们遭到某种怪物袭击，如今被困在这里。她提到过一位船长，或许我该去找他。

source: Aid the Anubites
Captain Asim sent scouts along to coast to find a way off the island, though they didn't return. Maybe I'll have better luck.
target: 阿西姆船长派出斥候沿海岸寻找离岛的办法，但他们没有回来。也许我的运气会好些。

target: 将小船的消息告诉女祭司。

source: I've found some boats along the coastline, I should inform Preistess Ameni back at the Anubite camp so they can make their escape.
target: 我在海岸边找到了一些小船。该回阿努比斯族营地通知阿梅妮女祭司，让他们乘船逃离。

source: Find the Anubites weapons.
target: 寻找阿努比斯族人的武器。

source: Captain Asim mentioned how during the shipwreck they lost their armaments with the ship. If I can find and return these, they may stand a chance should the creature return.
target: 阿西姆船长提到，船难时他们的武器装备也随船沉没了。若能找到并归还这些装备，怪物再来时，他们或许还能有一战之力。

source: Return the supplies to the Priestess.
I've found the Anubites armaments, I should return them to the camp.
target: 我找到了阿努比斯族人的武器装备。该把它们带回营地。

source: Inform the Priestess of my successful hunt.
target: 将狩猎成功的消息告诉女祭司。

source: I've managed to find and kill the Kravenrook, the Priestess back at the Anubite camp would be delighted to hear about this.
target: 我找到了克拉文鲁克，并将其杀死。阿努比斯族营地的女祭司听到这个消息，一定会很高兴。

source: Collect the reliquary.
Priestess Ameni has given me her blessing to carry the reliquary on her behalf, I should go and collect it.
target: 阿梅妮女祭司允许我代她携带圣物匣。我该去把它取来。

source: Speak to Captain Asim and Decide the Anubite's Fate
target: 与阿西姆船长交谈，决定阿努比斯族人的命运

source: Priestess Ameni has asked me to inform the Captain of my success.
target: 阿梅妮女祭司让我把成功的消息告诉船长。

source: Kill the creature.
I've discovered a creature that may be the one that attacked the Anubites, if I manage to kill it they would be able to rest easy.
target: 我发现了一只怪物，它可能就是袭击阿努比斯族人的凶手。若能杀死它，他们就能安心了。

Travel to Mehden Island
Damaris has told me that Mehden island may have a blacksmith which can remove my mask, I should go there and find them.
target: 达玛瑞斯说，梅登岛上可能有位铁匠能替我取下面具。我该去那里找找。

source: Search for the Blacksmith
I have landed on Mehden Island, I should look for this Blacksmith
target: 我已经登上梅登岛，该寻找那位铁匠了。

target: 我发现自己来到了一座陌生的岛屿，不清楚之前究竟发生了什么。我应该寻找其他幸存者。

source: Enter the lair of the beast
I've discovered a strange tomb entrance, the nearby statues and Effigies are related to a twisted creature knowns as a Kravenrook.
target: 我发现了一个奇怪的墓穴入口。附近的雕像和偶像都与一种叫克拉文鲁克的扭曲怪物有关。

source: Investigate the lair
I must investigate the lair of The Kravenrook.
target: 我必须调查克拉文鲁克的巢穴。

source: Escape the room by burning the effigy
I've been trapped in a room with the Kravenrook, the creature can appear anywhere at any moment as long as the Effigy remains.
target: 我被困在一间房里，克拉文鲁克也在其中。只要偶像还在，那怪物就能随时出现在任何地方。

source: Find and Kill the creature
Having narrowly avoided death, I must delve further into the creature's lair and kill the creature
target: 我刚刚死里逃生，必须继续深入巢穴，杀死那只怪物。

source: Defeat the Kravenrook
By killing the Kravenrook I can escape this tomb and save the Anubites
target: 杀死克拉文鲁克，就能逃离墓穴，救下阿努比斯族人。

source: Clear Kehm Farmstead of enemies
Kehm Farmstead is swarming with foes. I must defeat them.
target: 凯姆农庄到处都是敌人。我必须击败他们。

source: Exterminate the Bloodseeker encampment
I've discovered an encampent of Bloodseekers--bloodthirsty cannibals who find pleasure in carnage and eating their victims alive. I should end their miserable existence.
target: 我发现了一处觅血者营地。这群嗜血的食人族以屠杀和生吞受害者为乐。我该结束他们可悲的性命。

source: Meet Amara at The Shrine of Ascension
target: 在升华神龛与阿玛拉会面

source: A mysterious woman asked me to meet her at The Shrine of Ascension. She made it sound like something of great importance that should be done quickly.
target: 一位神秘女子让我去升华神龛见她。听她的意思，这事十分重要，必须尽快去办。

source: Commune with The Shrine
The mysterious woman told me to transfer my essence into The Shrine of Ascension, whatever that means. Perhaps touching it will be enough. Anything to get this mask off...
target: 神秘女子让我将精华注入升华神龛，不知道这是什么意思。或许摸一摸就行。只要能把这面具摘下来……

source: Talk to Amara
I've communed with the shrine. I should speak to the mysterious woman now.
target: 我已与神龛沟通。现在该和那位神秘女子谈谈。

source: Learn and use a Sorcery

I have learned that I can use Sorcery, the kind of mystical abilites such as those of the Felreq, but I need to learn them at The Shrine of Ascension. Once I've learned, I should show the mysterious woman what I can do.
target: 原来我也能施展法术，就像费尔雷克的神秘能力一样。但我得先在升华神龛学习。学会之后，该向那位神秘女子展示一下。

source: Find and retrieve the lost sceptre
The mysterious woman told me about the artifact she used to teleport herself to The Shrine of Ascension. Apparently a karrow bird flew off with it, but if I find it, I can keep it.
target: 神秘女子提到，她曾用一件神器将自己传送到升华神龛。那东西似乎被一只卡罗鸟叼走了，不过如果我能找回来，就归我所有。

source: (Optional) Read the five Tenets
Herdmaster Reseph told me to read about the tenets of the Gilded Fold. They are engraved in pillars within the Gilded Fold's compound, and there should be five of them in total.
target: 牧长雷瑟夫让我了解金辉牧团的信条。它们刻在牧团驻地的石柱上，一共应该有五条。

source: Speak to Reseph
I've read the tenets and should return to Herdmaster Reseph to discuss what I've learned.
target: 我读过信条了，该回去和牧长雷瑟夫谈谈自己的收获。

source: Capture Sehet
Herdmaster Reseph has agreed to take me on as his apprentice, but first I need to learn the basics. He's given me a capture jar and told me to use it on one of the slaves named Sehet.
target: 牧长雷瑟夫同意收我为徒，但我得先学会基础。他给了我一个捕捉罐，让我拿一名叫塞赫特的奴隶练习。

source: Place Sehet in the cage
I've successfully captured Sehet! Now I need to expell her from my capture jar to place her back into her cage as Herdmaster Reseph instructed.
target: 我成功抓到了塞赫特！现在得按照牧长雷瑟夫的指示，把她从捕捉罐中放出，送回笼子里。

source: I've done as Herdmaster Reseph asked. I should speak to him.
target: 我照牧长雷瑟夫说的做了。该和他谈谈。

source: Find and capture your slave
Herdmaster Reseph has sent me off to capture my very first slave! There are some prime candidates hiding in a cave not far from here.
target: 牧长雷瑟夫让我去捕捉属于自己的第一个奴隶！离这里不远的洞穴里，藏着一些很合适的目标。

source: Return to Reseph
I've captured my first slave. I should return to Herdmaster Reseph and show him.
target: 我抓到了第一个奴隶。该回去给牧长雷瑟夫看看。

source: Get on the cart
Wrangler Sotema needs help protecting her cart from bandits on the way to and from a farm. I've agreed to help, and she's waiting for me to get onto her cart before we set off.
target: 赶车人索特玛需要有人保护货车，防止往返农场的途中遭到强盗袭击。我答应帮忙。她正等我上车，然后就出发。

source: Save the village
The village Sotema is supposed to get supplies from is under attack by Inquisitors of Bast. Sotema has already rushed to the village's rescue. I should join her!
target: 索特玛要去采购补给的村庄遭到了巴斯特审判官的袭击。她已经冲去救援，我也该赶过去！

source: Collect supplies
We were too late to do much, and most of the village was masacred. There's still a job to be done though, and Sotema has asked me to gather supplies to take back to the Gilded Fold.
target: 我们来得太晚，没能救下多少人，村里大多数人都被屠杀了。但活还得干，索特玛让我收集补给，带回金辉牧团。

source: Return to the cart
I've gathered all of the supplies I can. I should return to Sotema's cart and ride with her back to the Gilded Fold compound.
target: 能拿的补给我都收集好了。该回到索特玛的货车旁，和她一起返回金辉牧团驻地。

source: Find Nergaal's Tomb
There is an ancient warlord named Nergaal who harbored the recipe to a special elixir Mesatnofreht thinks can help save the afflicted villagers. I must find the tomb.
target: 古代军阀涅尔加尔掌握着一种特殊药剂的配方。梅萨特诺芙蕾特认为，这种药剂能拯救染病的村民。我必须找到他的墓穴。

source: Enter Nergaal's tomb
I've found Nergaal's Tomb. Time to go in.
target: 我找到了涅尔加尔之墓。该进去了。

source: Find the recipe
I've entered Nergaal's Tomb. Now to find the recipe for Mesatnofreht.
target: 我已经进入涅尔加尔之墓。现在得替梅萨特诺芙蕾特找到配方。

source: Read the recipe inscriptions
Segments of the recipe I seek are etched onto tablets inside Nergaal's Tomb. I should search the place for more etchings until I find the complete recipe.
target: 我要找的配方被分段刻在涅尔加尔墓内的石板上。我该继续寻找铭文，直到拼出完整配方。

source: Defeat Nergaal
It turns out Nergaal isn't entirely dead. I'm trapped with nowhere to run. I must defeat Nergaal if I want to leave this place alive.
target: 原来涅尔加尔还没死透。我被困在这里，无路可逃。想活着离开，就必须击败他。

source: Return to Mesatnofreht
target: 返回梅萨特诺芙蕾特处

source: I've found all the parts to the recipe, and even one of the ingredients. I should return to Mesatnofreht with the news.
target: 我找全了配方，甚至还找到了其中一种材料。该回去把消息告诉梅萨特诺芙蕾特。

source: Gather the ingredients
I must gather the rest of the ingredients for the ancient elixir. Mesatnofreht knows where they can be found.
target: 我必须收齐这种古代药剂所需的其余材料。梅萨特诺芙蕾特知道去哪里找。

source: I've gathered all the necessary ingredients. I should return to Mesatnofreht quickly so she can brew the elixir and save the villagers.
target: 所需的材料已经全部集齐。我该尽快回到梅萨特诺芙蕾特身边，让她配制药剂，拯救村民。

source: Delve into Kab'Alrah
I've found an ancient tomb called Kab'Alrah. Who knows what treasures may be found within? Like most tombs, the idea of entering it is foreboding. I should be warry of potential danger.
target: 我发现了一座名叫卡布阿尔拉的古墓，谁知道里面藏着什么宝物？不过和大多数墓穴一样，光是想到要进去就让人不安。我得提防潜在的危险。

source: Find the stolen jar
Temarah mentioned she's searching for a runaway slave. The slave has stolen a jar from her, and Temarah wants it back.
target: 特玛拉说，她正在追捕一名逃跑的奴隶。奴隶偷走了她的一个罐子，她想把它找回来。

source: Take the jar to Temarah
I found the slave, and the jar. Although it seems to have cracked, I should return it to Temarah.
target: 我找到了奴隶和罐子。虽然罐子似乎裂了，还是该把它还给特玛拉。

source: Meet with the Anubites
It would seem the Anubites are causing Safiya great distress. I should look into it. Maybe I can negotiate a peace between them.
target: 看来阿努比斯族人让萨菲娅十分困扰。我该了解一下，也许能让双方和解。

source: Create a distraction for Mera to escape
target: 制造动静，掩护梅拉逃走

source: Mera is ready to make her escape from Ikenni Villa. I need to distract her sisters so she can slip away.
target: 梅拉已经准备好逃离伊肯尼庄园。我得分散她姐妹们的注意力，让她悄悄溜走。

source: Find Mera
Mera has made her escape. She shouldn't have gone far. I should look for her outside Ikenni Villa.
target: 梅拉已经逃出来了，应该还没走远。我该去伊肯尼庄园外找她。

source: Speak with Safiya

Sergeant Tabu has agreed to allow me to make a deal with Safiya. If I can convince her to share her adopted daughters with his soldiers, then he will make sure that the priestess will allow Safiya access to her pool.
target: 塔布军士同意让我和萨菲娅谈条件。只要我能说服她，让士兵们享用她收养的女儿，他就会确保女祭司允许萨菲娅使用水池。

source: Meet with Tabu
Safiya has accepted the deal to share her daughters. I should return to Tabu with the good news.
target: 萨菲娅答应让士兵们享用她的女儿。该把好消息带给塔布了。

source: Collect five sandscale minnow
Badeel of the Gilded Fold needs aid in feeding the flock. Catching at least five sandscale minnow for him should be enough.
target: 金辉牧团的巴迪尔需要人帮忙喂养牲畜。替他抓至少五条沙鳞鲦鱼应该就够了。

source: Turn in your catches
I've caught five sandscale minnow. I should place them into the barrel near Badeel.
target: 我抓到了五条沙鳞鲦鱼。该把它们放进巴迪尔旁边的桶里。

source: Find the herder a drink
I ran into a herder who is dying for a drink. Maybe if I grab him one he'll put in a good word for me with The Fold.
target: 我遇到了一位口渴难耐的牧人。或许给他弄点喝的，他就愿意在牧团里替我说几句好话。

source: Bring a drink to the herder
I've found a drink. I should return to the thirsty herder.
target: 我找到喝的了。该回去找那位口渴的牧人。

source: Meet Damaris outside
target: 在外面与达玛瑞斯会面

source: Damaris has asked me to join her for a walk outside.
target: 达玛瑞斯邀我一起出去散步。

source: Make your decision
I need to decide how to approach my relationship with Demaris.
target: 我得决定如何对待自己与达玛瑞斯的关系。

source: Find Damaris at the Taberna
I should seek out Damaris at The Rampant Lioness.
target: 我该去“昂首雌狮”酒馆寻找达玛瑞斯。

source: Talk to Damaris
I should speak with Damaris.
Regain Damaris' trust
target: 重新赢得达玛瑞斯的信任

source: Damaris undoubtedly hates me, but maybe I'll be able to regain her trust later.
target: 达玛瑞斯现在肯定恨透了我，不过以后也许还有机会重新赢得她的信任。

source: Help Amonhoteph
I've met an old warrior named Amonhoteph. He seeks a warrior's death by a worthy foe. I am to defeat him in honorable combat and send his spirit to Keth-Eros.
target: 我遇到了一位名叫阿蒙霍特普的老战士。他希望死在一位值得尊敬的对手手中。我得在光荣的决斗中击败他，将他的灵魂送往凯特埃罗斯。

source: Learn to fish with Moswen
Moswen has offered to teach me to fish, and surprisingly with no strings attached. He's offered me his pole to use.
target: 莫斯温愿意教我钓鱼，居然没有附带任何条件。他还把自己的鱼竿借给我用。

source: Catch your first fish with Moswen
target: 在莫斯温的指导下钓到第一条鱼

source: Moswen has asked me catch a fish while he watches.
target: 莫斯温让我在他的注视下钓一条鱼。

source: Recieve permission from Safiya
Mera is stricly forbidden from intimate interactions with any outsiders without Mother's permission. I should speak to Safiya about this.
target: 没有母亲的许可，梅拉严禁与任何外人亲热。我该就此和萨菲娅谈谈。

source: Give Mera the good news
I've secured a treaty between the Anubites and Safiya, granting me access to her handmaidens, including Mera. I should speak with Mera.
target: 我促成了阿努比斯族与萨菲娅之间的协议，因此获准与她的侍女亲近，梅拉也在其中。我该和梅拉谈谈。

source: Free Khalia
I found a woman bound up by the Inquisition of Bast. I should free her.
target: 我发现一名女子被巴斯特审判庭绑了起来。我该救她。

source: Speak to Khalia
I've freed Khalia. I should speak with her now.
target: 我救出了卡莉娅。现在该和她谈谈。

source: Follow the suspicious villager
A suspicious looking villager was watching me as I freed Khalia. I assumed the Inquisition killed everyone else. I should follow this villager to find out who they are.
target: 我救卡莉娅时，有个形迹可疑的村民一直盯着我。我原以为其他人都被审判庭杀了。该跟上去，查清这个人是谁。

source: Follow the stranger inside
The suspicious villager has disappeared into a house. I should follow her inside.
target: 那个可疑的村民钻进了一间屋子。我该跟她进去。

source: Investigate the depths of the house
The house is not all it seems to be. I should delve deeper in search of the suspicious villager.
target: 这间屋子并不像表面那么简单。我该继续深入，寻找那个可疑的村民。

source: Speak with the suspicious villager

I followed the suspicious villager to into an exotic refuge carved out beneath the house. She caught me off guard, but spared my life. I should speak to her to learn more about who she is, and what she's doing.
target: 我跟着可疑的村民，来到房屋地下开凿的一处别致藏身所。她打了我一个措手不及，却饶了我一命。我该和她谈谈，弄清她的身份与目的。

source: Help Tefahra or leave

I've learned that the suspicious villager is a woman named Tefahra, an Inquisitor of Bast. I stand at a crossroads. Do I help her in her supposedly noble cause? Or do I simply leave and forget this meeting ever happened?
target: 原来那个可疑的村民叫特法拉，是巴斯特的审判官。我得做个选择：帮助她完成那所谓的崇高事业，还是直接离开，当作这次会面从未发生？

source: Find the Anubite orgy
target: 寻找阿努比斯族人的性爱聚会

source: I've agreed to help Tefahra, but she wishes to test my dedication first. I must interrupt an Anubite orgy. The first step is to locate it.
target: 我答应帮助特法拉，但她想先考验我的决心。我必须打断一场阿努比斯族人的性爱聚会，第一步是找到地点。

source: Deal with the Anubite orgy
target: 处理阿努比斯族人的性爱聚会

source: I've found the Anubite orgy. Now, according to Tefahra, I must find a way to interrupt it, lest they continue to perpetuate the horrible curse affecting everyone.
target: 我找到了阿努比斯族人的性爱聚会。按照特法拉的说法，我必须想办法打断他们，否则他们会继续延续那影响所有人的可怕诅咒。

source: Return to Tefahra in Maz-Arjeni
target: 返回马兹阿尔杰尼寻找特法拉

source: I've dealt with the Anubite orgy-goers. Now I must return to Tefahra in her hideout beneath Maz-Arjeni.
target: 我处理了参加性爱聚会的阿努比斯族人。现在得回马兹阿尔杰尼地下的藏身处找特法拉。

source: Search for clues to Tefahra's whereabouts
target: 寻找特法拉去向的线索

source: I've returned to Tefahra's hideout beneath Maz-Arjeni, but she isn't here. Perhaps she left a clue to where she went off to around here somewhere.
target: 我回到了马兹阿尔杰尼地下的藏身处，特法拉却不在。也许她在这里留下了去向的线索。

source: Speak to Tefahra at the Rampant Lioness
target: 在“昂首雌狮”与特法拉交谈

source: I've discovered that Tefahra has moved to the taberna known as The Rampant Lioness on Tal'Senet. I should find her there. According to the note she left me, I should bring her a Blood-Reed Tonic to show I am still a friend of her order.
target: 我得知特法拉去了塔尔塞内特的“昂首雌狮”酒馆。我该去找她。她留下的字条说，让我带一瓶血芦补剂，证明我仍是她所属教团的朋友。

source: Go to Kab'Alrek
Tefahra has tasked me to stop the Anubites from recovering a ritual vessel that was sealed in a tomb called Kab'Alrek. I should make my way there.
target: 特法拉让我阻止阿努比斯族取回一件封存在卡布阿尔雷克墓穴里的仪式容器。我该动身前往。

source: Infiltrate the tomb
I've found Kab'Alrek, but the Anubites are already inside. Going through the front door will no doubt end in bloodshed. Perhaps there's a way I could sneak in.
target: 我找到了卡布阿尔雷克，但阿努比斯族人已经进去了。走正门肯定会引发厮杀，或许有办法悄悄潜入。

source: Deal with the priestess
Deep within Kab'Alrek, I've discovered an Anubite Priestess attempting to use the ritual vessel. I should take care of her.
target: 在卡布阿尔雷克深处，我发现一位阿努比斯族女祭司正试图使用仪式容器。我该处理掉她。

source: Leave Kab'Alrek
With the Anubite priestess defeated, it's safe to say their excursion is over. I should return to Tefahra with the good news.
target: 阿努比斯族女祭司已被击败，他们的行动算是结束了。该回去把好消息带给特法拉。

source: Speak to the Inquisitor
Some Inquisitors have arrived, if only they had arrive a bit sooner... Nevertheless, I should speak to their leader.
target: 一些审判官赶到了，要是他们能早来一点就好了……不管怎样，该和他们的首领谈谈。

source: Return to Tefahra
It appears the Inquisitors have things at Kab'Alrek sorted. I should report back to Tefahra.
target: 看来审判官已经控制了卡布阿尔雷克的局面。我该向特法拉汇报。

source: Choose a path
Tefahra wishes to induct me into the Inquisition of Bast! I've been given the choice of three different methods through which I may devote myself. I should let Tefahra know my choice.
target: 特法拉想让我加入巴斯特审判庭！我可以通过三种不同的方式奉献自己。该告诉她我的选择。

source: Meet Tefahra in her hideout
target: 在藏身处与特法拉会面

source: Tefahra wishes to induct me into the Inquisition of Bast! I need to find her in her hideout and then make my choice. I've been given the choice of three different methods through which I may devote myself.
target: 特法拉想让我加入巴斯特审判庭！我得去她的藏身处，做出自己的选择。我可以通过三种不同的方式奉献自己。

source: Complete the Trial of Pain
I've chosen the Trial of Pain. Now I must endure, for Bast.
target: 我选择了苦痛试炼。为了巴斯特，我必须忍耐。

source: Complete the Ritual of Temptation
I've chosen to go through the Ritual of Temptation. I must remain steadfast for Tefahra, and for Bast.
target: 我选择接受诱惑仪式。为了特法拉，也为了巴斯特，我必须坚定不移。

source: Complete the Plea of Deliverance
I've choses to devote myself to Bast through the Plea of Deliverance. May Bast hear my words.
target: 我选择以救赎祈求向巴斯特献身。愿巴斯特聆听我的话语。

source: Speak to Tefahra
I did it. I successfully performed the rite. I should speak to Tefahra to finalize my induction into the Inquisition.
target: 我做到了，仪式顺利完成。我该和特法拉谈谈，正式加入审判庭。

source: Search for Amhak
An Anubite priestess named Amansi has asked me to look for Amhak, her 'dimwitted half-brother'. There must be someone around here who knows where he went...
target: 一位名叫阿曼西的阿努比斯族女祭司让我寻找阿姆哈克，她那“脑子不灵光的同父异母兄弟”。附近总该有人知道他去了哪里……

source: Find Amhak's ruins
target: 寻找阿姆哈克提到的遗迹

source: According to Amhak's journal, there's a ruined tomb known not far from here. He apparently believes it contains a ritual vessel, and has gone off in search of it. I should look for these ruins.
target: 阿姆哈克的日记提到，附近有一座残破的墓穴。他似乎相信里面藏着一件仪式容器，已经动身去寻找了。我该找找那片遗迹。

source: Find Kab'Sehet
I spoke with Amhak's servant who told me Amhak went to explore some nearby ruins, a tomb called 'Kab'Sehet'. I should make my way there.
target: 阿姆哈克的仆人告诉我，他去探索附近一座名叫“卡布塞赫特”的墓穴遗迹了。我该去那里。

source: I've found Kab'Sehet. Amhak must be within. I should have a look around.
target: 我找到了卡布塞赫特。阿姆哈克一定在里面，我该四处看看。

source: Find Amhak
I've found some ruins nearby the Anubite encampment. Perhaps this is where Amhak went? I should have a look around.
target: 我在阿努比斯族营地附近发现了一片遗迹。阿姆哈克会不会去了那里？我该四处看看。

source: Save Amhak
I've found Amhak, but he's trapped. I should eliminate the enemies keeping him trapped.
target: 我找到了阿姆哈克，但他被困住了。我得消灭困住他的敌人。

source: Speak to Amhak at the Anubite camp
target: 在阿努比斯族营地与阿姆哈克交谈

source: I've successfully saved Amhak. I should check in on him back at the Anubite camp.
target: 我成功救出了阿姆哈克。该回阿努比斯族营地看看他。

source: Speak to Astari
It seems Amhak's other half-sister, Astari, would like a word with me.
target: 看来阿姆哈克的另一位同父异母姐妹阿斯塔莉想找我谈谈。

source: Speak to Amhak
Now Amhak wishes to speak with me. To offer thanks, no doubt. It sure feels good to be helpful.
target: 现在阿姆哈克也想和我谈谈，想必是要道谢。能帮上忙的感觉真不错。

source: Delve into the mysteries of the cave
I've discovered a strange cave. The very air emanating from it feels... strange. I should investigate.
target: 我发现了一处奇怪的洞穴。洞里透出的气息都让人觉得……古怪。我该调查一下。

source: Defeat Inquisition raiders
Maz-Arjeni is under attack. I must defeat the Inquisition and free the woman they appear to have tied up.
target: 马兹阿尔杰尼正遭到袭击。我必须击败审判庭，救下那个似乎被他们绑住的女子。

source: Explore deeper into Maz-Arjeni Tomb
target: 深入探索马兹阿尔杰尼墓穴

source: I've entered into the Maz-Arjeni Tomb, it appears to be filled with the Inquisition.
target: 我进入了马兹阿尔杰尼墓穴，里面似乎到处都是审判庭的人。

source: Free the captives
I've found tied up Captives being held here, I can help. I have a bad feeling about this.
target: 我发现了一些被绑起来关押在这里的俘虏，可以救他们。不过我有种不祥的预感。

source: Find out what is required for the ritual
I've offered to 'tread the Path' with an Anubite called Asman, I should find out what he needs from me.
target: 我答应和一位名叫阿斯曼的阿努比斯族人一同“踏上圣道”。该问问他需要我做什么。

source: Search for the "Sacred" Oils of Preparation
Asman has asked me to find the "Sacred" Oils of Preparation. They should be somewhere nearby, surely any Oil will do.
target: 阿斯曼让我寻找准备仪式的“圣”油，应该就在附近。想必随便什么油都行吧。

source: Return to Asman
I've found the oils! I should return to Asman.
target: 我找到油了！该回去找阿斯曼。

source: Search for the Sacred Rug of Repose
I've now been sent to find the Sacred Rug of Repose, surely it's around here somewhere.
target: 现在他又让我寻找安歇圣毯，肯定就在附近某处。

source: I've got the rug, I should bring it back to Asman.
target: 我拿到毯子了，该带回去给阿斯曼。

source: Search for the Sacred Incense of Insight
Asman has now asked me to find the Sacred Incense of Insight. He said that it'd probably be near where I found the Sacred Oil.
target: 阿斯曼又让我去找洞察圣香。他说，应该就在先前找到圣油的地方附近。

source: I can't find any Sacred Incense of Insight around, I should let Asman know.
target: 我到处都找不到洞察圣香，该告诉阿斯曼。

source: Bring Farkos some Melinh Wine
target: 为法尔科斯带来梅林葡萄酒

source: A minoan has demanded I bring him a local drink, I've heard some locals talking about 'Melinh Wine' so hopefully that'll do. There must be a bar nearby I can purchase it from.
target: 一个米诺安族人命令我给他带点本地的酒。我听当地人提过“梅林葡萄酒”，希望那个能合他心意。附近应该有酒馆卖。

source: Bring Farkos some Yellow Sweetwater
target: 为法尔科斯带来黄色甜水

source: Farkos hated the wine and is now demanding some Yellow Sweetwater, the nearby bar should sell it.
target: 法尔科斯讨厌那葡萄酒，现在又要黄色甜水。附近的酒馆应该有卖。

source: Bring Farkos some Minot Brandy
target: 为法尔科斯带来米诺特白兰地

source: ... Farkos hated the Yellow Sweetwater as well and is now demanding Minot Brandy. There must be some at the bar.
target: ……法尔科斯连黄色甜水也不喜欢，现在又要米诺特白兰地。酒馆里肯定有。

source: Bring Nisu some Girin-Da
I've bumped into Nisu who mid-threesome has asked me to fetch her some lube, specifically Girin-Da She said that Hasina should have some in stock.
target: 我碰到了正在玩三人行的妮苏。她让我去拿点润滑剂，还特别指定要吉林达。她说哈西娜那里应该有货。

source: Find a musician
Nisu has now asked me to bring her a musician, hopefully one will be lurking around here somewhere.
target: 妮苏现在又让我给她找个乐师。希望附近就有一个。

source: Return to Nisu
Apet has agreed to play for Nisu, I should check in with her.
target: 阿佩特答应为妮苏演奏。我该回去看看她。

source: Find Nisu's friend
Nisu has now asked me to pass a message to a friend of hers- they need to go and see her for 'the usual'. She should be on Tal-Senet alongside her husband.
target: 妮苏让我替她给一位朋友捎个口信，叫对方来找她，还是“老样子”。那位朋友应该和丈夫一起待在塔尔塞内特。

source: Catch up with Amhak over some drinks
I've met up with Amhak outside the Taberna, I should find out if he has any clues relating to more Vessels.
target: 我在酒馆外遇到了阿姆哈克。该问问他有没有其他容器的线索。

source: Investigate Amhak's Camp for clues
target: 调查阿姆哈克的营地，寻找线索

source: Amhak has been investigating clues relating to more Ritual Vessels, I should check with him and the Artefacts in his camp
target: 阿姆哈克一直在调查其他仪式容器的线索。我该去问问他，再看看营地里的古物。

source: Speak with Amhak
I've inspected Amhak's tomb findings and they all point to one location - Kab'Siron, I should speak to him about it.
target: 我查看了阿姆哈克从墓穴中找到的东西，线索都指向同一个地方：卡布西隆。我该和他谈谈。

source: Find Kab'Siron
All of Amhak's notes relate to a Dungeon on Mehden Island called Kab'Siron, we should head there to look for any clues.
target: 阿姆哈克所有的笔记都指向梅登岛上一处叫卡布西隆的地牢。我们该去那里寻找线索。

source: Rendezvous with Amhak
I've entered Kab'Siron, I should meetup with Amhak so we can uncover it's mysteries together.
target: 我已经进入卡布西隆。该和阿姆哈克会合，一起揭开这里的秘密。

source: Find another route
Amhak has fallen through a trap door and is lost, I can't follow him, I'll have to find another way through.
target: 阿姆哈克踩中活板门掉了下去，失去了踪影。我没法跟着跳，只能另找一条路。

source: Solve the puzzle
I've found a flooded room with no clear way to get across the broken Aqueduct, maybe it has something to do with these water valves?
target: 我找到一间积水的房间，没有明显的路线能越过断裂的引水渠。也许和这些水阀有关？

source: I've found a way to flood the room to get across, I'll find Amhak in here somewhere
target: 我找到了让房间灌水、从而通过的办法。阿姆哈克一定就在里面某处。

source: Defeat the Shade of Nethyra
Amhak by nearing the Vessel of Nethrya has summoned a terrifying Crocodilian monster, hopefully by killing it we can grab the Vessel and make it out alive.
target: 阿姆哈克靠近奈瑟拉的容器时，召出了一只可怕的鳄人怪物。希望杀死它之后，我们就能拿着容器活着离开。

source: Obtain the Vessel of Nethrya
The beast has been defeated and I'm somehow still alive, let's grab the Vessel and get out of here.
target: 野兽被击败了，我居然还活着。拿上容器，赶紧离开吧。

source: Return to Amansi at the Anubite Camp
target: 返回阿努比斯族营地寻找阿曼西

source: Now I've got the Vessel, I should head back to Amansi in the Anubite Camp and see if this was worth the effort.
target: 我拿到容器了。该回阿努比斯族营地找阿曼西，看看这番辛苦是否值得。

source: Loot the Anubite Armoury
target: 搜刮阿努比斯族军械库

source: I've chosen a key to the Anubite Armory, I should grab the weapon and see what other rewards await me around the camp.
target: 我选择了阿努比斯族军械库的钥匙。该去拿武器，再看看营地里还有什么奖励等着我。

source: Find the Farmstead owner
Investigate the Farm
Track the source of blood
Find the Farmer
Find a way to save the Formless
target: 寻找拯救无形者的办法

source: I've found a shipwrecked Gilded Fold herder with some drowning caged formless, it appears the key has been lost with the wreckage nearby.
target: 我遇到一位遭遇船难的金辉牧团牧人。他押运的无形者被困在笼子里，眼看就要淹死，而钥匙似乎遗失在附近的船骸中了。

source: Negotiate with the Inquisitor
An Inquisitor has shown up and has taken issue with simply freeing the slaves from drowning only to hand them over to slavery, I need to make my choice of their fate even if this means conflict.
target: 一位审判官出现了。他不认同把奴隶救出水后再送回奴役的做法。我必须决定他们的命运，即使这会引发冲突。

source: Find the Pleasure Palace
I've heard rumour of a place nearby full of desire and pleasure, I should check it out, seems right up my alley.
target: 我听说附近有个充满欲望与欢愉的地方。该去看看，听起来正合我的口味。

source: Enter the pleasure palace
Having found the pleasure palace and the less than enthused attendant, I should head inside.
target: 我找到了欢愉宫，还有那个不怎么热情的侍者。该进去了。

source: Investigate the Pleasure Palace
I appear to have been trapped inside, hopefully this is for my benefit, but I'm beginning to get concerned, I should take a look around.
target: 我似乎被困在里面了。希望这是为了让我尽兴，可我已经有些担心了，得四处看看。

source: Defeat the Inquisition Ambush
I've been ambushed by an overly zealous Inquisitor, it's do or die.
target: 一位狂热的审判官伏击了我。现在不是他死，就是我亡。

source: Escape the Pleasure Palace
Having defeated the Inquisitor, I should use that key I looted to make it out the back alive.
target: 我击败了审判官。该用搜到的钥匙从后面逃出去。

source: Find the Aadi seller
I've found a note from a stablemaster on Tal'Senet, he's gone to Mehden island, if I find them, I can buy my own Aadi.
target: 我在塔尔塞内特找到一张马厩主管留下的字条，他去了梅登岛。找到他，我就能买一只自己的阿迪兽。

source: Inquire about a Mount
I've found Hakor, I should see about acquiring my own steed.
target: 我找到了哈科尔，该问问怎么才能拥有自己的坐骑。

source: Purchase an Aadi
I've acquired an Aadi on trial from Hakor, if I pay him 1,000 gold, I can get the mount as my very own.
target: 哈科尔让我试用一只阿迪兽。付给他1000金币，这只坐骑就正式归我了。

source: Find the meeting point
I've received a strange and urgent note telling me to come to the Ruins of the Sacred Steps to retrieve an important item.
target: 我收到了一张古怪而急迫的字条，要我前往圣阶遗迹取一件重要物品。

source: Investigate the Standoff
I've discovered both the Anubites and the Inquisition fighting over the ruins, this is looking like trouble.
target: 我发现阿努比斯族和审判庭正在争夺遗迹，看来有麻烦了。

source: Resolve the Situation
There's a simple dispute between a Copper Merchant and a Buyer, it appears the area is littered with complaints, I should investigate and settle the matter.
target: 一位铜商和买家起了争执，周围似乎散落着不少投诉。我该调查一下，解决此事。

source: I've come across bickering Anubite and Gilded Fold members over the sale of a Slave, I think I can resolve this issue without any bloodshed.
target: 我遇到阿努比斯族人与金辉牧团成员，双方正为一名奴隶的买卖争执。我想可以不流血就解决这件事。

source: Choose your side
I must choose by side between the Anubites and the Inquisition on who should take the Artifact.
target: 我必须在阿努比斯族与审判庭之间选择一方，决定神器归谁。

source: Win the Battle
I've chosen to side with the Cult of Anubis, for now, and I must help kill the Inquisitors to retrieve the Voice of Amun.
target: 我选择暂时支持阿努比斯教团，必须帮他们杀死审判官，夺回阿蒙之声。

source: I've chosen to side with the Inquisition of Bast, for now, and I must help kill the Anubites to retrieve the Voice of Amun.
target: 我选择暂时支持巴斯特审判庭，必须帮他们杀死阿努比斯族人，夺回阿蒙之声。

source: Speak to Mehsu
I've retrieved the Voice of Amun, I need to speak to Mehsu to discuss the next steps.
target: 我取回了阿蒙之声，得找梅赫苏商量下一步行动。

source: Speak to Nehma
I've retrieved the Voice of Amun, I need to speak to Nehma to discuss the next steps.
target: 我取回了阿蒙之声，得找内赫玛商量下一步行动。

source: Kill Mehsu
I've chosen to betray the Anubites and bring the Voice of Amun to the Inquisition, I must kill Mehsu.
target: 我选择背叛阿努比斯族，将阿蒙之声交给审判庭。我必须杀死梅赫苏。

source: Kill Nehma
I've chosen to betray the Inquisition and bring the Voice of Amun to the Anubites, I must kill Nehma.
target: 我选择背叛审判庭，将阿蒙之声交给阿努比斯族。我必须杀死内赫玛。

source: Obtain the Voice of Amun
There's some sort of Magical Force preventing me from just taking the Artifact. There must be a way to break the spell around here.
target: 某种魔力阻止我直接取走神器。附近一定有解除法术的办法。

source: Hand over the Voice of Amun to Astari
target: 将阿蒙之声交给阿斯塔莉

source: Hand over the Voice of Amun to Astari.
target: 将阿蒙之声交给阿斯塔莉。

source: Hand over the Voice of Amun to Karo
Hand over the Voice of Amun to Karo.
Talk to the Baker
I've witnessed a thief making off with some bread from the Baker in Dhrakoq port, this injustice needs investigating.
target: 我看见一个小偷从德拉科克港的面包师那里偷了些面包逃走。这种不法之事需要调查。

source: Search for the Thief
I've offered to help a baker search for a Thief that keeps stealing from them, since they keep going there they must live nearby. I should search the area.
target: 我答应帮一位面包师寻找总来偷东西的小偷。既然常来，他一定住在附近。我该搜索这一带。

source: Decide what to do with the Thief
I've found the Thief, I could head back to the Baker now and let her know about him. Alternatively there must be some way I could convince him to stop stealing.
target: 我找到了小偷，现在可以回去告诉面包师。或者，也许还有办法说服他不再行窃。

source: Return to the Cook
I've had a word with the Thief, he won't be a problem anymore. I should let the Baker know.
target: 我已经和小偷谈过，他不会再惹麻烦了。我该告诉面包师。

source: I've given the Thief some money to get them back on their feet, hopefully now they'll leave the Baker alone. I should let them know.
target: 我给了小偷一些钱，让他能重新站稳脚跟。希望他以后别再骚扰面包师了，我该回去说一声。

source: Deal with the Vigilante
The Baker hired a Vigilante to take care of the Thief. I need to find and stop him before it's too late!
target: 面包师雇了个私刑者去处理小偷。我得赶在太迟之前找到并阻止他！

source: Bring the Voice of Amun to Astari
target: 将阿蒙之声带给阿斯塔莉

source: Now I have the Artifact - the Voice of Amun, I need to bring it to the Anubites, it cannot be in the Inquisiton Control. Astari will know what to do.
target: 我拿到了神器阿蒙之声，得把它交给阿努比斯族，绝不能让审判庭控制它。阿斯塔莉会知道该怎么办。

source: Await further Instructions
To be Continued...
Bring the Voice of Amun to Karo
Now I have the Artifact - the Voice of Amun, I need to bring it to the Inquisition, it cannot be in the Anubites Control. Karo will know what to do.
target: 我拿到了神器阿蒙之声，得把它交给审判庭，绝不能让阿努比斯族控制它。卡罗会知道该怎么办。

source: Investigate the Strange Cries
I can hear some odd noises coming from a nearby pot, is someone stuck?
target: 附近一个罐子里传来奇怪的声音，是有人被卡住了吗？

source: Free Onha from the Jar
I've discovered a helpless but clearly aroused stranger trapped inside a pot, I should see what I can do to help, maybe I can get hold of some Fish Oil from a vendor..
target: 我发现一个陌生人被卡在罐子里，动弹不得，却明显很兴奋。我该想办法帮她，也许能从商人那里弄点鱼油……

source: Return to Onha with the Lube
target: 带着润滑剂返回昂哈处

source: I've managed to find some Fish Oil, let's see if this can help get her lubed up and out of the pot.
target: 我找到了鱼油，看看能否给她润滑一下，让她从罐子里出来。

source: Journey to the Temple of Pahnu

After speaking to Amara at the Shrine of Ascension, to gain more power and change the world I need to obtain the essence of demigods. For the essence of Pahnu I need to travel to their temple in the desert.
target: 在升华神龛与阿玛拉交谈后，我得知想获得更多力量、改变世界，就需要取得半神的精华。要获得帕努的精华，我得前往沙漠中的神殿。

source: Investigate the temple
I've arrived in the temple in the desert, let's investigate.
target: 我来到了沙漠中的神殿，四处调查一下吧。

source: Aid the Mouth of Pahnu
I've discovered and spoken to the Mouth of Pahnu, I think it won't speak to me unless I satiate it's thirst.
target: 我找到了帕努之口，也试着与它交谈。但看来不先替它解渴，它就不会理我。

source: Speak to the Mouth of Pahnu
After watering the tree, I can speak to the Mouth and unlock the next steps.
target: 我给树浇了水，现在可以与帕努之口交谈，了解接下来该怎么做。

source: Attune to the Elements - Seek the Ancient Shrines
target: 与元素共鸣——寻找古代神龛

source: The Mouth of Pahnu won't grant me access to the Labyrinth until I attune myself to the Land, Sea and Sky. I need to find their shrines and attune with the elements if I want the essence.
target: 帕努之口要求我先与大地、海洋和天空共鸣，才肯让我进入迷宫。想取得精华，就必须找到它们的神龛，与这些元素建立联系。

source: Return to the Mouth of Pahnu
I've attuned to all three elements of Land, Sea and Sky and now I can proceed with my journey back to the Mouth of Pahnu.
target: 我已与大地、海洋和天空三种元素共鸣，现在可以回去找帕努之口，继续旅程。

source: Enter the Temple of Pahnu
I've been granted access, let's continue onward into the Temple.
target: 我获得了进入许可，继续深入神殿吧。

source: Navigate Pahnu's Labyrinth
I've found that the temple is based on the ivy covered grounds of an Ancient Labyrinth, hopefully Pahnu is in the middle.
target: 原来神殿建在一座爬满常春藤的古老迷宫中。希望帕努就在迷宫中央。

source: Speak with the Demi-God Pahnu
I've found Pahnu, I need to obtain their essence.
target: 我找到了帕努，必须取得祂的精华。

source: Defeat Pahnu
Enough talk, surely I can obtain Pahnu's essence by defeating them.
target: 说够了，只要击败帕努，肯定就能取得祂的精华。

source: Return to Amara at the Shrine of Ascension
target: 返回升华神龛寻找阿玛拉

source: I've obtained the essence, I can now return to Amara at the Shrine fo Ascension
target: 我取得了精华，现在可以回升华神龛找阿玛拉。

source: Deal with the Dune Bugs
Pahnu won't part with any essence until I prove that I can tend to the land, I can clear out some Dune Bug nests nearby to hopefully appease the Demi-God.
target: 帕努要我证明自己懂得照料这片土地，才肯给我精华。我可以清理附近的沙丘虫巢，希望能让这位半神满意。

source: Speak to Pahnu
After burning many Dune Bug nests, I've proved I can tend to the land and hopefully Pahnu will give me the essence I need.
target: 我烧毁了许多沙丘虫巢，证明自己能够照料土地。希望帕努会把我需要的精华交给我。

source: Touch the Shrine to begin Purification
I've found one of the Shrines of Elements, the Shrine of Sea. I need to touch it to attune to the Shrine.
target: 我找到了元素神龛之一：海洋神龛。需要触碰它，才能与之共鸣。

source: Survive the trial of the Sea Shrine
target: 通过海洋神龛的生存试炼

source: The shrine is testing me by expunging dark creatures, I feel that if I survive the onslaught that I'll be worthy to meditate here.
target: 神龛释放出黑暗生物来考验我。我感觉只要撑过这轮猛攻，就有资格在这里冥想。

source: Meditate at the Shrine
I've survived the purging and now I can meditate and attune to the Sea.
target: 我撑过了净化试炼，现在可以冥想，与海洋共鸣。

source: Return to the Shrine Area to restart the Ritual
target: 返回神龛区域，重新开始仪式

source: After leaving the area I can feel that the shrine has become dormant once again, if I return I should be able to re-start the ritual.
target: 离开这片区域后，我能感到神龛再次陷入了沉寂。回去应该就能重新开始仪式。

source: Pass the trials to activate the Shrine of Land
target: 通过试炼，激活大地神龛

source: I've found the Shrine of the Land, it appears to be dormant and is surrounded by void  magic. Perhaps by completing the puzzling trials the shrine will activate.
target: 我找到了大地神龛。它似乎处于沉寂状态，周围环绕着虚空魔法。或许完成这些解谜试炼，就能激活它。

source: Meditate at the Shrine of Land
I've activated the shrine of Land and now I can meditate and attune to the Land.
target: 我激活了大地神龛，现在可以冥想，与大地共鸣。

source: Traverse the Sky to reach the Sky Essence
target: 踏空而行，抵达天空精华处

source: I've found one of the Shrines of Elements, the Shrine of Sky. I need to touch it to attune to the Shrine. There appears to be a faint whispy path in the sky that I can traverse to make my way to the Shrine.
target: 我找到了元素神龛之一：天空神龛。需要触碰它，才能与之共鸣。空中似乎有一条若隐若现的缥缈路径，可以沿它抵达神龛。

source: Speak to Amhak and Nepthys
target: 与阿姆哈克和奈芙蒂斯交谈

source: I've found Amhak and Nepthys in Wased-Heq, they seem to be discussing something important.
target: 我在瓦塞德赫克找到了阿姆哈克和奈芙蒂斯，他们似乎在讨论重要的事情。

source: Catch up with Amhak at the Temple of Anubis
target: 前往阿努比斯神殿与阿姆哈克会合

source: Make the journey to Wased-Heq
Find the Anubite Barracks
Nepthys has offered me a place in the Anubite Barracks to rest after my travels.
target: 奈芙蒂斯说，我旅途劳顿，可以去阿努比斯族兵营休息。

source: Earn a bunk in the ring
The Barrack's Captain is making me prove myself to earn a bunk in the Barracks. Fisticuffs it is.
target: 兵营队长要我先证明自己，才能获得一个床位。看来得靠拳头说话了。

source: DUD RN FOR SOME KINDA EVENT
Take a well earned Rest
Having given the Barrack's Captain a good fisting, it's time to take a break and take a hard earned rest in the bunks.
target: 我已经用拳头好好教训了兵营队长，是时候喘口气，躺上辛苦赢来的床位休息了。

source: Return to Nepthys and Amhak
target: 返回奈芙蒂斯和阿姆哈克处

source: I've never felt so refreshed despite all the bumps in the night. I better get back to Nepthys, Amansi and Amhak.
target: 虽然夜里折腾不断，我却从未感觉如此神清气爽。该回去找奈芙蒂斯、阿曼西和阿姆哈克了。

source: Travel to the Tomb of Q'Tesh
The High Priestess, Nepthys, has requested that a ritual vessel be recovered from the Tomb of the Ascended.
target: 大祭司奈芙蒂斯让我从升华者之墓中取回一件仪式容器。

source: Find the ritual vessel
I've found the Tomb of Q'tesh, at least some entrance into this cursed place, now I need to find the ritual vessel.
target: 我找到了克泰什之墓，至少找到了进入这鬼地方的一处入口。现在得找到仪式容器。

source: Defeat the Void Titan to Obtain the Sealed Vessel of Q'Tesh
target: 击败虚空泰坦，取得克泰什的封印容器

source: The Sealed Vessel is being guarded by some giant creature of the void, I'll need to kill this creature to take the vessel back to Nepthys.
target: 封印容器由一只巨大的虚空生物看守。我得杀死它，才能把容器带回给奈芙蒂斯。

source: Pickup the Sealed Vessel of Q'Tesh
target: 拾取克泰什的封印容器

source: Now the Tomb Guardian has been defeated, I can retrieve the Sealed Vessel of Q'Tesh.
target: 墓穴守卫已被击败，现在可以取走克泰什的封印容器了。

source: Return to Nepthys
I have defeated the Tomb Guardian and retrieved the Sealed Vessel of Q'Tesh, I can now return to Nepthys.
target: 我击败了墓穴守卫，取回了克泰什的封印容器。现在可以回去找奈芙蒂斯。

source: Speak to TEF
Tefahra has requested that the Sealed Ritual vessel be recovered from the Tomb of the Ascended, stealing it from the Anubites.
target: 特法拉让我从升华者之墓取回封印仪式容器，将它从阿努比斯族手里偷走。

source: Find the Sealed Ritual Vessel of Q'Tesh
target: 寻找克泰什的封印仪式容器

source: Defeat the Void Titan to obtain the Ritual Vessel
target: 击败虚空泰坦，取得仪式容器

source: The Sealed Ritual Vessel is being guarded by some giant creature of the void, I'll need to kill this creature to take the vessel back to Tefahra.
target: 封印仪式容器由一只巨大的虚空生物看守。我得杀死它，才能把容器带回给特法拉。

source: Pick up the Sealed Vessel of Q'Tesh
target: 拾取克泰什的封印容器

source: I have defeated the Tomb Guardian and retrieved the Sealed Vessel of Q'Tesh, I can now return to Tefahra at her hideout.
target: 我击败了墓穴守卫，取回了克泰什的封印容器。现在可以回她的藏身处找特法拉。

source: Speak to Esi
One of the Adepts of the Temple is here making camp outside the Tomb, I should speak to her.
target: 一位神殿修士正在墓穴外扎营，我该和她谈谈。

source: Investigate the body and area
One of the Adepts of the Temple is dead here, having made camp outside the Tomb, I should investigate.
target: 一位在墓穴外扎营的神殿修士死在这里，我该调查一下。

source: Find Khaba the Scribe
I should follow the river to the scribe's house.
target: 我该沿河前往书吏的住处。

source: Speak to Khaba
I've found Khaba the Scribe at their home, I should speak to them and investigate the void.
target: 我在书吏卡巴家里找到了他。该和他谈谈，调查虚空的事。

source: Find Khaba's servant
Return to Khaba
Search for the ancient ruins
Khaba has told me of ruins that supposedly house a gateway between this world and The Void. Laughed off as a children's story by Esi, perhaps this place really is a door to a place beyond reality.
target: 卡巴提到一片遗迹，据说那里藏着连接现实世界与虚空的门。艾西把这当作小孩子的传说，一笑置之，但也许那里真是一道通往现实之外的门户。

source: Unlock the Mysteries of the Ruins
There are four statues marked with symbols that spin freely on their plinth. Perhaps a specific alignment of these is all that's needed to open the gateway.
target: 这里有四座刻着符号的雕像，可以在底座上自由旋转。或许只要按特定方式排列它们，就能打开门户。

source: Enter the temple
Find the hidden weapon
It was trivial to open the gateway to The Void... baffling really that nobody had done it already. Now I've entered this void space, I need to find this hidden weapon.
target: 通往虚空的门户竟然这么容易就打开了……之前居然没人做到，真令人费解。我已经进入这片虚空，现在得找到藏在这里的武器。

source: Speak to the void spirit
A void spirit has appeared within this strange place, I should speak to them.
target: 一个虚空之灵出现在这奇异的地方，我该和它谈谈。

source: Gather Evidence to Find the Thief

The Watch have asked me to search for a thief that's been plaguing the docks. I should ask around to try and track the thief down before confronting anyone. The various tradespeople are a good bet, one of them must have seen something.
target: 城卫队让我追查一个在码头频频行窃的小偷。在找人对质前，我该先四处打听，追查他的下落。各种行当的人都值得问问，总有人见过什么。

source: Confront the Black Felian
I have a description of the suspect, a distincive one at that. I should confront the Black Felian and put a stop to this spate of thefts.
target: 我得到了嫌疑人的外貌描述，特征十分明显。我该找那名黑色猫人对质，制止接连发生的盗窃。

source: Determine the fate of Iraya
I must choose the thief's fate, though no choice will be without consequence for myself. With a single decision I could make powerful friends, or dangerous enemies.
target: 我必须决定这个小偷的命运，但无论怎么选，我自己都会承担后果。一念之间，我可能交到强大的朋友，也可能树立危险的敌人。

source: Condemned Iraya to the watch
I have chosen to condemn Iraya to the watch, no doubt straight into the hands of the Merchant Guild.
target: 我选择将伊拉娅交给城卫队，无疑也就是把她送进商人公会手里。

source: Enslaved Iraya
I've chosen to capture Iraya, I suppose I may as well sell her myself.
target: 我选择捕捉伊拉娅。既然如此，不如亲自把她卖了。

source: Freed Iraya
I've chosen to let Iraya go, surely her crimes do not warrant such awful fates.
target: 我选择放走伊拉娅。她的罪行应该还不至于让她遭受那些可怕的命运。

source: Investigate the body
I've found the body of someone murdered in the street, maybe I should check it out.
target: 我发现街上有一具被谋杀者的尸体，也许该查看一下。

source: Report the body to the Watch
The body has been mutilated, I should report it to the guards.
target: 尸体遭到了肢解，我该向守卫报告。

source: Find and speak to potential witnesses:
target: 寻找可能的目击者并交谈：

source: To get to the bottom of these killings I should speak to any potential witnesses.
target: 想查清这些凶杀案，我该找所有可能的目击者谈谈。

source: Find a Scribe
The Jackal mentioned a scribe, perhaps there's one around here who can help identify the markings.
target: 那个豺狼人提到了一位书吏，也许附近就有人能帮忙辨认这些符号。

source: Speak to the Stranger
There's a Draconid that's acting a bit suspicious, I should see if they saw anything.
target: 有个龙裔行为有些可疑，我该问问他是否看见了什么。

source: Follow the Stranger
After mentioning Atá the Draconid ran, saying to follow them since 'it's not safe to mention that name here'. I should catch up to them.
target: 我一提到阿塔，那个龙裔就跑了，还让我跟上，说“这里不方便提那个名字”。我该追上去。

source: I've caught up to the Draconid and now they've locked me out, I should see what they have to say.
target: 我追上了龙裔，他却把我关在门外。我该看看他有什么话说。

source: Defeat Mered
I've refused to aid Mered and now he's attacking me, I need to defend myself.
target: 我拒绝帮助梅雷德，他便向我发起了攻击。我得自卫。

source: Read the Tome
Mered mentioned a tome is what told him to kill people, I should check it out.
target: 梅雷德说，是一本典籍指使他杀人。我该读一读。

source: Speak to Mered
I've refused to help Atá, I should return to Mered and turn him in.
target: 我拒绝帮助阿塔，该回去找梅雷德，把他交出去。

source: Decide the Scribe's fate
Atá has asked me to kill the scribe, I should decide if I'll help with the killings.
target: 阿塔让我杀死书吏。我该决定是否帮他继续杀人。

source: Kill the Scribe
I've decided to aid Atá in killing the scribe, I should pay them a visit.
target: 我决定帮阿塔杀死书吏，该去拜访对方了。

source: I refused to kill the scribe and now Atá has instead asked me to bring Mered to Uket's shrine. I should go and grab him.
target: 我拒绝杀死书吏，阿塔便改口让我把梅雷德带到乌凯特的神龛。我该去找他。

source: Go to Uket's shrine
I need to lead Mered to Uket's shrine.
target: 我得带梅雷德去乌凯特的神龛。

source: Deal with Mered
We've arrived at Uket's shrine, time to see what Atá plans with Mered.
target: 我们来到了乌凯特的神龛，看看阿塔打算如何处置梅雷德。

source: I've managed to get the Draconid to open the door and speak to me, let's figure out what's going on.
target: 我设法让龙裔打开门，愿意和我谈谈。现在来弄清到底是怎么回事。

source: Atá has decided that Mered will be a worthy enough sacrifice to free him.
target: 阿塔认定，梅雷德足以成为让自己重获自由的祭品。

source: Kill Mered
I've determined that Mered must die to attone for his crimes.
target: 我认定梅雷德必须以死赎罪。

source: Decide Mered's Fate
Mered is begging for mercy and his life, I must choose.
target: 梅雷德正苦苦求饶，请我放他一条生路。我必须做出选择。

source: Cook a Fruit Medley
I've run into a Chef who believes I'm part of his team and has demanded I make him a Fruit Medley with the nearby ingredients. Perhaps I should play along and see what I can learn.
target: 我遇到一位厨师，他以为我是手下的帮厨，命令我用附近的食材做一份什锦水果。或许该顺着他的意思，看看能打听到什么。

source: Hand the Fruit Medley to Kordon
target: 将什锦水果交给科尔登

source: I've made the Fruit Medley! I should bring it back to Kordon to see what he thinks.
target: 我做好了什锦水果！该拿给科尔登，看看他怎么评价。

source: Cook Emerald Skewers
Kordon has now demanded I cook him some Emerald Skewers, surely he'll like those.
target: 科尔登现在又让我做些翡翠烤串。这次他总该喜欢了吧。

source: Hand the Emerald Skewers to Kordon
target: 将翡翠烤串交给科尔登

source: I've made the Emerald Skewers! Now I need to hand them over to Kordon.
target: 我做好了翡翠烤串！现在得把它们交给科尔登。

source: Cook Candied Nunut
Kordon also hated the Emerald Skewers and is now sending me to make some Candied Nunut. Perhaps this time he'll actually like it.
target: 科尔登也讨厌翡翠烤串，现在又让我去做蜜饯努努特。也许这回他终于会满意。

source: Hand the Candied Nunut to Kordon
target: 将蜜饯努努特交给科尔登

source: I've made the Candied Nunut, time to bring them back to Kordon.
target: 我做好了蜜饯努努特，该拿回去给科尔登。

source: Search for clues
I've encountered a Ritual Vessel that appears to be leaking. Perhaps if I can find a way to fix it, I could take its power for myself.
target: 我遇到一个似乎正在泄漏的仪式容器。或许只要找到修复的方法，我就能将它的力量据为己有。

source: Read the Inquisitor's Journal
There was a dead Inquisitor nearby, perhaps their journal contains some information about what happened here.
target: 附近有一名死去的审判官，也许他的日记里记载了这里发生的事。

source: Reseal the Ritual Vessel
According to the Inquisitor's journal the Ritual Vessel can be resealed with the use of the Void, perhaps using a Void sorcery on it would do the trick?
target: 根据审判官的日记，可以借助虚空重新封印仪式容器。也许对它施放虚空法术就行？

source: Pick up the Ritual Vessel
I've managed to reseal the Ritual Vessel, I should grab it before anyone else gets to it.
target: 我成功重新封印了仪式容器，得赶在别人之前拿走它。

source: I've encountered an Inquisitor who has been injured while fighting off some Cursed Ones. I should see what they were up to.
target: 我遇到一位审判官，他在抵御受诅咒者时受了伤。我该问问他们在做什么。

source: Collect the Ritual Vessel
The Inquisitor has succumbed to their wounds, I should grab the Ritual Vessel before it causes more problems.
target: 审判官伤重不治。我该拿走仪式容器，免得它惹出更多麻烦。

source: Find the Inquisition's Shrine
The Inquisitor mentioned a Shine, perhaps I should do as they asked and destroy the Ritual Vessel there.. Or maybe I could use it for myself.
target: 审判官提到一座神龛，也许我该照他的请求，去那里摧毁仪式容器……也许也能把它留给自己用。

source: Defeat the Shrine Guardian
It seems the Shrine was warded against non-Inquisitors, I need to take care of this Guardian.
target: 神龛似乎设有针对审判庭以外之人的防护。我得解决这个守卫。

source: Destroy the Ritual Vessel

I've found the Inquisition Shrine as well as a chest that's locked with some kind of spell. Maybe it was intended as a reward for the Inquisitor after they destroyed the Ritual Vessel. That being said.. I could still use the Ritual Vessel for myself instead.
target: 我找到了审判庭的神龛，还有一只被法术锁住的箱子。也许它原本是给摧毁仪式容器的审判官的奖励。话虽如此……我仍然可以把仪式容器留给自己用。

source: Investigate the commotion
I've encountered a couple arguing over what appears to be some dug up treasure, I should check it out.
target: 我遇到一对正在争吵的人，争执的东西似乎是他们挖出的宝藏。我该看看。

source: Trouble in Paradise
After suggesting only one of them gets the treasure a fight has broken out between the duo. I should probably leave them alone.. But I could use this as my chance to get the treasure for myself.
target: 我提议宝藏只归其中一人，结果两人打了起来。我大概该让他们自己解决……不过也可以趁机把宝藏据为己有。

source: Kill Hamnet & Shira
I've decided that I want the treasure for myself, I should take care of these two first.
target: 我决定独占宝藏，得先解决这两个人。

source: Search the chest
The treasure is mine for the taking!
Find the treasures
It turns out the treasure chest had just contained a couple of maps, perhaps I can find the real reward if I track them down.
target: 原来宝箱里只有几张地图。也许顺着地图找下去，才能得到真正的奖励。

source: Speak to the Slave
I've encountered a runaway Slave collapsed in the sand, I should see if I can help them.
target: 我遇到一名逃跑的奴隶，瘫倒在沙地上。我该看看能否帮忙。

source: Bring the Slave some water
I've brought the Slave to the shade but they're in dire need of something to drink. I should find some water for them.
target: 我把奴隶带到了阴凉处，但对方急需喝点东西。我该找些水来。

source: Kemma must be somewhere nearby, I will recognise her by her necklace set with blue gemstones
target: 凯玛一定就在附近。我可以凭她那条镶着蓝色宝石的项链认出她。
